task.title: Configuring Redis
task.shortdesc: To configure Redis for your proof of concept Red Hat Quay deployment, you can start a Redis container with Podman and expose port 6379 with a password. Red Hat Quay uses Redis for live builder logs during image builds.

context.p: Redis is a key-value store that is used by Red Hat Quay for live builder logs.

step.cmd: Start the Redis container, specifying the port and password, by entering the following command:

info.codeblock: $ sudo podman run -d --rm --name redis \ -p 6379:6379 \ -e REDIS_PASSWORD=strongpassword \ registry.redhat.io/rhel9/redis-6:latest
